title: Syrian Tagine with Jasmine Petals
description: A traditional Middle Eastern-inspired dish featuring the delicate flavors of rose and jasmine, perfect for a warm evening.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or make your own with cinnamon, ginger, and cumin

instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together rose petal jam and infused rose water (if using).
Brush the chicken with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the chicken in a baking dish and spoon the rose petal mixture over the top.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the jasmine tea by steeping the tea leaves in boiling water for 5-7 minutes.
Strain the tea and discard the leaves.
Serve the chicken with the jasmine tea poured over the top, garnished with additional rose petals if desired.
